finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an einem gegebenen Modell einer neuronalen Erkrankung, zum Beispiel Alzheimer, erklären, wie eine Störung neuronaler Strukturen oder Signalprozesse die Funktion des Systems verändert.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can use a supplied model of a neuronal disorder, such as Alzheimer's, to explain how a disturbance of neuronal structures or signalling processes changes the function of the system.

decisions.rationaleDe: Technische Zusammenführung der echten unabhängig versiegelten A-/B-Erstbewertungen des gleichen vollständigen aktuellen bilingualen Ziels, nativer Seite und Quellen-/Bild-/Kontexteingänge. Alle originalen Records, Run-IDs und Campaign-IDs bleiben exakt. Keine neue fachliche Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. A: The bilingual descriptions ask for one causal explanation from a supplied neuronal disease model, not classification or diagnosis of all diseases. HE physical43 supports the model principle with Alzheimer/Parkinson examples. BY EA explicitly names MS/Parkinson, so BY support remains partial and does not turn Alzheimer into a BY obligation. Explaining a supplied neuronal alteration through its effect on system function is one model competence. Naming alternative disease examples does not create independently required disease competencies. B: The complete German and English descriptions assess one causal explanation from a supplied neuronal-disorder model. Alzheimer is explicitly an example; this does not require interchangeable disease labels, diagnosis or a complete account of disease causation. The actual page and canonical context agree, including HE/BY applicability and boundary inheritance. The HE physical43 LK source supports a principle-level neuronal-disorder example. BY EA11 provides only a partial structural/signalling component toward its mandatory MS/Parkinson symptoms competence; it does not mandate Alzheimer.
decisions.rationaleEn: Technical factual synthesis of genuine sealed independent A/B first-pass judgments over identical whole current bilingual goals, native pages and source/image/context inputs. Original records, runs and campaign identifiers are retained exactly. No new scientific review or human approval. A: In the supplied disease model, neural connections and signalling processes support information processing; changing those structures or processes can impair system function. The model relationship does not establish an individual diagnosis. B: A neuronal structure or signalling process disturbed in the supplied model can change system function; the model explains a bounded relationship.

finalText.titleDe: Elektrische Summensignale bei ENG und EKG erklären
finalText.titleEn: Explain aggregate electrical signals in nerve conduction studies and ECG
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an gegebenen Modellen von ENG und EKG erklären, wie Oberflächenelektroden elektrische Spannungsunterschiede als Summensignal ableiten, wie ein angegebener Signalvergleich begrenzt zur Funktionsbeurteilung genutzt wird und warum daraus weder Einzelzellpotenziale noch ein Hirnbild oder eine eigenständige Diagnose folgen.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can use supplied models of nerve conduction studies (German ENG) and ECG to explain how surface electrodes record electrical potential differences as an aggregate signal, how a supplied signal comparison can support a bounded assessment of function, and why it gives neither single-cell membrane potentials nor a brain image or an independent diagnosis.

decisions.rationaleDe: Technische Zusammenführung der echten unabhängig versiegelten A-/B-Erstbewertungen des gleichen vollständigen aktuellen bilingualen Ziels, nativer Seite und Quellen-/Bild-/Kontexteingänge. Alle originalen Records, Run-IDs und Campaign-IDs bleiben exakt. Keine neue fachliche Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. A: DE/EN identify surface electrical potential differences as an aggregate recording, bounded use of a supplied comparison, and limits concerning single cells, brain images and diagnosis. English disambiguates German ENG as nerve conduction studies. Original BY EA competence9 and the adjacent explicit ENG/EKG content support this bounded method model. Neither GA nor HE support is asserted. Cardiac tissue is distinguished from peripheral nerves rather than described as neurons. One competence explains aggregate surface electrical recording and bounded interpretation. ENG and ECG serve as contrasting applications of the same recording principle. The supplied speed/rate formulas are supports for interpreting the given model, not separately required calculation routines or clinical-method training. B: Both whole descriptions correctly describe a supplied extracellular surface-recording model and bounded interpretation. Peripheral nerve ENG and cardiac ECG have different tissue sources and uses; they are connected by one measurement principle and inference competence. The BY EA source explicitly names ENG and EKG under neurophysiological procedures, while GA omits that duty. BY-only LK applicability and partial e026 route are appropriate; HE requires a brain-imaging procedure, which this goal neither claims nor supplies.
decisions.rationaleEn: Technical factual synthesis of genuine sealed independent A/B first-pass judgments over identical whole current bilingual goals, native pages and source/image/context inputs. Original records, runs and campaign identifiers are retained exactly. No new scientific review or human approval. A: In the supplied models, nerve conduction studies and ECG measure differences between surface electrode potentials arising from electrical cellular contributions weighted in space and time. Peripheral nerve conduction and cardiac electrical activity are distinct sources whose timing comparisons provide bounded information about function. B: Nerve conduction studies and ECG record electrical contributions distributed in space and time as a potential difference at surface electrodes; interpretation depends on tissue, recording model and context.

finalText.titleEn: Explain DNA Replication with a Simple Model
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung der DNA-Replikation erklären und an einem einfachen Modell zeigen, dass bei semikonservativer Replikation jeder neue DNA-Doppelstrang einen ursprünglichen und einen neu gebildeten Einzelstrang enthält.
finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the significance of DNA replication and use a simple model to show that, in semiconservative replication, each new DNA double strand contains one original and one newly formed single strand.

decisions.rationaleDe: Technische Zusammenführung der echten unabhängig versiegelten A-/B-Erstbewertungen des gleichen vollständigen aktuellen bilingualen Ziels, nativer Seite und Quellen-/Bild-/Kontexteingänge. Alle originalen Records, Run-IDs und Campaign-IDs bleiben exakt. Keine neue fachliche Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. A: The bilingual goal explains replication significance through the same simple semiconservative copying model. The prerequisite DNA-Aufbau supplies structural context. BW physical24/printed22 clause3.3.2(3) explicitly asks for simple-model duplication capability; the added BW support is a partial operationalisation, not complete coverage of the whole structure/information-storage bullet or a requirement for advanced enzyme mechanisms. Significance and strand tracing explain one DNA copying relation. The fresh round extends that same model; it does not import enzyme kinetics, a separate inheritance routine or mitosis assessment. B: Current German/English goal states the significance and strand-material invariant of one semiconservative copying model. Added BW applicability is supported by the actual printed22/physical24 standard3.3.2(3): DNA properties include duplication ability explained on a simple model. Semiconservative replication is a valid bounded model operationalisation of that component; this goal alone does not cover the whole DNA structure/information-storage bullet. Existing structure prerequisite and SekI scope remain appropriate.
decisions.rationaleEn: Technical factual synthesis of genuine sealed independent A/B first-pass judgments over identical whole current bilingual goals, native pages and source/image/context inputs. Original records, runs and campaign identifiers are retained exactly. No new scientific review or human approval. A: In semiconservative DNA replication, each existing single strand acts as a template for a complementary new strand. Original strands enter separate daughter DNA molecules; template copying can preserve sequence information even as original material becomes differently distributed. B: Complementary template copying preserves DNA sequence information, while each daughter model contains one original and one new strand after a copying round.
